verdict.rationale: YYLO is a CLI orchestrator for coding agents, so issuing scoped credentials to agents is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never documents creating, scoping or revoking API credentials or tokens for agents. Read-only preflight, isolated worktrees and non-mutating local views are related isolation controls, not credential issuance, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
